svg.text: OXYGEN · SG.3 · SUNRISE / SUNSET DATA FLOW · REVIEW BOARD
Provider sunrise and sunset must follow selected time.
Open-Meteo’s local daily events become scene inputs shared by every weather state.
Reference only; it does not show the proposed solar fix.
ONE CHICAGO DATE · PROVIDER LOCAL TIMES · SELECTED INSTANT STAYS AUTHORITATIVE

g.text: Position may move; time is selected.
Clouds and weather do not move sunset.

svg.text: BEHAVIOR CONTRACT · SHARED BY CLEAR, CLOUDY, RAIN, AND STORM SCENES
Request daily sunrise + sunset as Unix seconds → map each value to an Instant on its provider local date.
Catalog + recording/replay preserve each event; selected-date events flow into the shared scene reading.
The selected Instant remains exact: sunrise/sunset never retarget the timeline; scenes show no sun outside them.
DST uses provider local dates. Missing events stay unavailable; never guess 07:00/19:00 or a daily crossing.
Weather layers may soften or cover light, but cannot shift event times. This board is proposed design, not installed evidence.
Concept board · installed screenshot is composition reference only · proposed states require installed review.
Keep the blue buildings distant. On storm states, broad continuous cloud banks pass in front of the skyline;
they move as coherent masses, not repeated puffs. The same provider sunrise/sunset apply through every weather layer.
Chicago reference: 2026-10-31 · sunrise 07:22 · sunset 17:46 CDT · actual times vary by date and location.
